$comment: ONE neutral finish-boundary hook spec that WE own. emit-harness-hooks.sh compiles it into each present harness's native hook format (e.g. a Claude Stop hook). This is deliberately NOT an APM hook primitive — APM's hook compilation is unreliable today, so we emit natively ourselves. Scripts are resolved relative to the committed .spec-workflow/hooks/ directory at runtime.
description: Spec-Driven Development close-out / status-sync / version guard. Blocks finishing while a SPEC-* spec's acceptance criteria, status, or version have drifted.
